# Movie Seat Finder

> Find real nearby Fandango showtimes with reserved seating, inspect live seat maps, and identify adjacent available seats before buying tickets.

Movie Seat Finder is a free public web application. Showtime and seat availability come from Fandango and can change at any time. Ticket purchases are completed on Fandango.

## Pages

- [Movie Seat Finder](https://movieseatfinder.com/): Search by ZIP code or browser location, movie, theatre, format, date, time, party size, and preferred seat-map region.
- [FAQ](https://movieseatfinder.com/faq): Answers about search behavior, live data, theatre formats, seat maps, accessibility, privacy, and ticket links.

## MCP

- [MCP endpoint](https://movieseatfinder.com/mcp): Public Streamable HTTP endpoint; no authentication required.

The MCP server exposes a discovery-first workflow:

- `get_location_and_movie_info` finds nearby theatres, movie titles, dates, and formats.
- `find_movie_seats` searches for matching showtimes and adjacent seats.
- `show_movie_seat_map` refreshes a selected showtime and returns a visual seat map plus structured seat-group data.

Agents should ask for missing search details when their client supports questions. If a default is used, state the default to the user. Seat availability should be refreshed before presenting a final seat map or ticket link.

## Source

- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/ivan-grebe/movieseatfinder): Source code, setup instructions, tests, and issue tracking.
